title: 第五章再生变故第六章杀鸡儆猴者

小院的葡萄藤树下。
“大哥，你这手真的没办法康复吗？”
江黎微微摇头：“没有办法，筋断骨碎，右臂接近粉碎，若非有县尊发放的上等品质的疗伤药和止痛药，我现在大概都不能站在你面前。”
说到这里，他笑着摇摇头：“阿弟，你中午是说要练武对吧？”
“是的！”江宁点头。
“是该练武！！”江黎此刻露出深有感慨的表情，随后继续说道：“如今这个世道越来越乱了！拜神教越来越猖獗了！为了人造神灵也越来越疯狂，若非因为拜神教，我也不至于逢此大难！”
“拜神教？”江宁眼神一凝，心中瞬间想到两个月前发生的事情。
两个月前，自己穿越而来，便是身受重伤。
吸收当时前身的记忆后，遇袭后，他迷迷糊糊间听到“拜神教”三個字，也听到那样一句话：又找到一个天生灵慧者，摄取这道魂魄后定能得到神使的赏赐！
无疑，他就是那个天生灵慧者。
前身遇袭，在他看来极有可能是因为这个缘故被拜神教盯上。
也或许是因为那次意外，自己觉醒了前世宿慧，也可能是因为这个契机穿越而来。
究竟是何缘由，他也不得而知。
此刻再听到拜神教这三个字，令江宁心中不得不颇为重视。
至今他也不理解何为天生灵慧者，但是他知晓，假如自己前身因为乃是天生灵慧者被拜神教盯上，自己若是再被发现，难保不会再步这个后尘。
“阿弟，你怎么了？”看到江宁神色有些恍惚，江黎关切道。
“没什么，就是突然想到了一些事情。”江宁摇摇头。
听到这句话，江黎不由会心一笑：“放心吧！你要学武的事我已经安排妥当，为你寻得了一位良师。”
“良师？”江宁顿时摇头：“大哥不必如此，拜师学武太贵了，我们承担不起，只需要大哥教我几门武艺即可！”

“让我教伱武艺？”江黎顿时连连摇头：“这可不行！学武可不简单，不能乱教，也不能乱学，一旦出了岔子，后悔莫及。”
他又继续道：“况且如今我右手已废，左手持刀如何教你？我为你寻得的良师乃是沧浪武馆的王进，王进馆主乃是入品武者，实力远在我之上，且教学经验丰富，绝对算作一位良师。”
“沧浪武馆？王进？”江宁微微诧异，这些天他便览群书，又向自家大哥打听众多，自然是听过沧浪武馆王进的大名。
这是无数习武者都想拜入的武馆，一旦通过沧浪武馆的考验，成为武馆真正弟子，对于寻常人来说堪称一步登天，这一切不只是因为沧浪武馆的强大，更是因为王进的身份。
随后江宁摇摇头，他十分清楚拜入沧浪武馆需要缴纳多少银子。
即使大哥是捕快的身份，有吏籍加身，乃是朝廷的人，与沧浪武馆王进也是有所关联，但是也不会有任何例外。
随即江宁开口：“大哥，即使我真要寻个良师，也没必要是沧浪武馆，拜入沧浪武馆门下，这学费太过于昂贵了！”
“此事你不用担心！”江黎道：“我为衙门出身入死，为县尊出身入死，如今受此重伤，自然会有一笔衙门发放的抚恤金。”
他又小声的对江宁说道：“阿弟，这事你可别告诉你嫂子，县衙的抚恤金还要一段时间才会发放，我如今暂借了一些银钱给你当做拜师费，这事让你嫂子知道了又得唠叨我了。”
话音落下，江黎呵呵轻笑，故作轻松。
此刻江宁心中顿时五味杂陈，如此亲情，他前世从未感受过。
随后，江黎拍了拍他的肩膀：“夜深了，你先去睡吧！拜师的钱我已经交好了，所以你也不必再推迟，这笔拜师费可是退不了的，明日你乖乖与我同去沧浪武馆即可。”
留下这句话，江黎走向柳婉婉，俩人回屋。
......
次日一早，旭日东升，天色大亮。
突然间。
咚咚咚——
一阵敲门声响起。
“黎兄，在下徐云峰前来拜访！”
徐云峰？

听到这三个字江宁微微诧异，旋即瞬间回想起来。
之前大哥带自己去过衙门档案库一趟，自己也看过衙门的档案。
徐云峰，此人自幼无依无靠，曾与野狗夺食，为达目的不择手段，能走到这一步绝非善类。
最关键的是，此人乃是在曹彬曹捕头手下做事，而曹彬又是临江仙巨无霸之一，曹家的嫡系血亲。

Under the grapevine tree in the small courtyard.
"Brother, is it really impossible for your hand to recover?"
Jiang Li shook his head slightly: "There is no way. My tendons are broken, my bones are shattered, and my right arm is almost shattered. If it weren't for the high-quality healing medicine and painkillers distributed by the county magistrate, I probably wouldn't be able to stand in front of you now."
Having said this, he smiled and shook his head: "Brother, you said you wanted to practice martial arts at noon, right?"
"Yes!" Jiang Ning nodded.
"It's time to practice martial arts!!" Jiang Li showed a deeply emotional expression at this moment, and then continued: "Nowadays, the world is getting more and more chaotic! The God-Worship Cult is getting more and more rampant! I am getting more and more crazy for the artificial gods. If it weren't for the God-Worship Cult, I wouldn't be in this disaster!"
"God Worship Cult?" Jiang Ning's eyes narrowed, and his mind instantly thought of what happened two months ago.
Two months ago, I traveled through time and was seriously injured.
After absorbing the memory of his predecessor, after the attack, he vaguely heard the words "God Worship Cult" and also heard the sentence: If he finds another person who is born with spiritual wisdom, he will definitely be rewarded by the God's envoy after absorbing this soul!
There is no doubt that he is the one who is born with wisdom.
His predecessor was attacked, and in his opinion, it was most likely that he was targeted by the God Worship Cult for this reason.
Maybe it was because of that accident that I awakened the wisdom of my previous life, or maybe it was because of this opportunity that I traveled through time.
He didn't know exactly why.
Hearing the words God Worship Cult again at this moment, Jiang Ning had to take it seriously.
He still doesn't understand what a person with natural intelligence is, but he knows that if his predecessor was targeted by the God Worship Cult because he was a person with natural intelligence, if he is discovered again, there is no guarantee that he will not follow in the same footsteps.
"Brother, what's wrong with you?" Seeing Jiang Ning looking a little dazed, Jiang Li asked with concern.
"It's nothing, I just suddenly thought of something." Jiang Ning shook his head.
Hearing this, Jiang Li couldn't help but smile knowingly: "Don't worry! I have made arrangements for you to learn martial arts and found a good teacher for you."
"Good teacher?" Jiang Ning immediately shook his head: "Brother, you don't have to be like this. It's too expensive to learn martial arts from a teacher. We can't afford it. I just need eldest brother to teach me a few martial arts!"
"Let me teach you martial arts?" Jiang Li immediately shook his head: "That's not possible! Learning martial arts is not easy. You can't teach or learn indiscriminately. Once something goes wrong, you will regret it."
He continued: "Besides, now that my right hand is disabled, how can I teach you with a sword in my left hand? The good teacher I found for you is Wang Jin from Canglang Martial Arts School. The master of Wang Jin is a first-class martial artist. His strength is far superior to mine, and he has rich teaching experience. He can definitely be regarded as a good teacher."
"Canglang Martial Arts School? Wang Jin?" Jiang Ning was slightly surprised. These days, he had read a lot of books and asked his eldest brother a lot. Naturally, he had heard of Wang Jin of Canglang Martial Arts School.
This is a martial arts school that countless martial arts practitioners want to join. Once you pass the test of Canglang Martial Arts School and become a true disciple of the martial arts school, it is a step to the sky for ordinary people. This is not only because of the power of Canglang Martial Arts School, but also because of Wang Jin's identity.
Then Jiang Ning shook his head. He knew very well how much money he needed to pay to join Canglang Martial Arts School.
Even if the eldest brother is a police officer, has an official status, is a member of the imperial court, and is related to Wang Jin of Canglang Martial Arts School, there will be no exceptions.
Then Jiang Ning said: "Brother, even if I really want to find a good teacher, I don't need to be a disciple of Canglang Martial Arts School. The tuition fee is too expensive!"
"You don't have to worry about this!" Jiang Li said: "I risked my life for my yamen origin and my county honour. Now that I am seriously injured, I will naturally receive a pension from the yamen."
He whispered to Jiang Ning again: "Brother, don't tell your sister-in-law about this. It will take some time for the county government pension to be paid out. Now I have temporarily loaned you some money to pay for your apprenticeship. Now, let your sister-in-law know about this."Gotta nag me. "
After the words fell, Jiang Li chuckled, pretending to be relaxed.
At this moment, Jiang Ning felt a mixture of emotions in his heart. He had never felt such family affection in his previous life.
Later, Jiang Li patted him on the shoulder: "It's late at night, you should go to bed first! I have already paid the apprenticeship fee, so you don’t have to postpone it any longer. The apprenticeship fee is non-refundable. Just go to Canglang Martial Arts School with me tomorrow. "
Leaving these words behind, Jiang Li walked towards Liu Wanwan, and the two of them returned to the house.
...
Early the next morning, the sun rose in the east and the sky was bright.
suddenly.
Dong dong dong——
There was a knock on the door.
"Brother Li, Xu Yunfeng is here to visit! "
Xu Yunfeng?
Jiang Ning was slightly surprised when he heard these three words, and immediately recalled it.
My eldest brother took me to the yamen archives before, and I also looked at the yamen archives.
Xu Yunfeng, this person has been helpless since he was a child. He once competed with wild dogs for food and used any means to achieve his goals. It is definitely not a kind person to reach this point.
The most important thing is that this person works under Cao Bin, Cao Baotou, and Cao Bin is one of the Linjiang Immortal Giants and a direct blood relative of the Cao family.
